resolution.note: npm run lint runs scripts/task-quality.ts: tasks-only PRs (test shards skipped by ci-changes.mjs) are refused on a task-quality failure

title: krn task create refuses a body that fails a task-quality rule
body:
Why: lead created t-zdcrewe with krn task create; the task-quality rule measurable-outcome turned main red after #1016 merged, because scripts/ci-changes.mjs skips every test shard on a pull request that changes only task records (run 43700131643).
Outcome: npm run lint (the CI Lint job, run on every pull request including tasks-only ones) exits 1 when any task record fails a task-quality rule.
Files: scripts/task-quality.ts, package.json, src/brain/task-quality.ts, test/cli/task-quality.test.ts.
Proof: node scripts/task-quality.ts prints task-quality PASS on main; the allTaskQualityFailures test is red on a vague Outcome and green on a measured one.
Disposition: a create-time refusal in src/task/cli.ts was dropped: boundaries forbid task -> brain, and free-form bodies stay legal in adopted repos.
